title: 错误详情与诊断
intent: 技术信息收纳；导出诊断包仅显式触发。
brief: Global detail page with back link "返回处理". Title "错误详情". Plain sections "发生了什么" with "增强未产生可确认的输出，原图仍保留。"; "处理信息" rows route/step/job; "错误代码" value "示例代码"; screenshot placeholder "未捕获诊断截图"; disclosure "技术详情" closed. Primary "导出诊断包"; secondary "返回处理". title: 导入校验失败
intent: 多页PDF等不支持输入明确拒绝；原件保持不变。
brief: Home import family. Title "这份文件暂时不能处理". Amber inline panel "当前只支持单页 PDF。". Synthetic filename "多页示例.pdf"; note "文件未被修改，也没有启动处理。". Clear instruction "请先准备单页文件，再重新选择。". Primary "重新选择文件", secondary "返回主页". No unsupported page chooser, no pretending multi-page extraction is supported. Minimal file icon, no fox preview pretending decoded file.

intent: 只准备受管栅格副本，源文件不变、生产通道不沿用。

File illustration at left, required facts at right "PDF · 单页", "300 PPI", "原始文件保持不变"; note "准备后检查第 1 页及实际尺寸，再设置印刷尺寸。". Primary "准备单页预览"; secondary "重新选择文件". No fake rendered preview before prepare. Small compact supporting note "PSD 使用受管栅格副本；源专色不会直接成为生产通道。" No multi-page selector or keep-source-white.

title: AI设计分步接入
intent: 只呈现待接入设计，不承诺已有自动生图能力。
brief: Separate clearly labeled planned AI interface, top amber badge "规划预览 · 尚未接入". Sidebar stages "描述需求","参考附件","确认 Prompt" ACTIVE,"生成与接收","导入素材". Title "确认你的设计描述". Editor text "绘制一只橙色狐狸，周围有花叶，适合独立印花图案。". Prompt source/template controls minimal; selected attachments list "参考图.png · 手动上传清单", "需求说明.txt". Primary enabled design action "复制 Prompt". Disabled "开始生成" with explanation "等待 AI 业务能力接入". Secondary "手动回收图片" shown as conceptual fallback, not fake background monitoring. Small sentence "自动上传与结果接收由原 AI Epic 实现。" No browser brand claims, no generated progress or false success.
